thread:
emma: Customer on iPhone 14 Pro reports SSE stream gets truncated mid-response when they move from corp VPN -> home WiFi. App shows `Unexpected end of JSON input`. They say billing shows token usage for the partial response and want to avoid double-charging. Logs attached (see below).

raj: Thanks — can you paste the SDK version + sample request headers? Also did they use our hosted API or Dedicated?

emma: Hosted. SDK `redwood-js@2.1.0`. Headers: `Authorization: Bearer <redacted>`, `Connection: keep-alive`, `Accept: text/event-stream`. No proxy.

tyler: Do we have the customer repro steps? I can try to repro on Android emulator but need a quick network-flip script.

emma: Repro steps from customer: 1) Start a long SSE generation (30s+). 2) While streaming, toggle VPN off (corporate VPN app). 3) Immediately connect to home WiFi. Result: stream ends with final chunk truncated e.g. `{"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"..."},"finish_reas`.

ton: support-bot created ticket #SUP-10234 and linked customer logs: `stream-start -> partial-chunk -> tcp FIN from client`

oncall-sre: Quick hypothesis: looks like client TCP close while in mid-chunk then reconnect creates new TCP but client-side JSON parser gives error. Two things to check: 1) token TTL / rotation — if they refresh token during the swap it can trigger server-side connection close. 2) intermediate NAT/proxy dropping half-open connections on change of network.

raj: Can you grab the server-side logs around the stream? We need to know whether our runtime emitted a 4xx/5xx prior to TCP FIN.

emma: Paste from customer trace (redacted):
```
[2026-03-16T12:03:21Z] req_id=abc123 stream_start model=gpt-redwood-1
[2026-03-16T12:03:43Z] partial_chunk_sent bytes=1187 seq=42
[2026-03-16T12:03:45Z] connection_reset_by_peer
[2026-03-16T12:03:45Z] stream_terminated_incomplete reason=tcp_reset
```

tyler: That `connection_reset_by_peer` looks client-side. On mobile the socket can be torn down by OS when network interface changes. Two mitigation options for customers: 1) client should buffer and validate JSON boundaries — drop partial chunk and reconnect/resume with a small application-level checkpoint, or 2) implement idempotent chunking on server that emits explicit chunk framing (we already include `event: chunk` but customer parser expects raw JSON).

oncall-sre: Also check token refresh: if client refreshes the bearer mid-stream and performs a new TLS handshake, some proxies will close old connection. Recommend asking customer to extend token TTL during tests or perform refresh only after stream ends.

raj: For immediate triage: can we add a short server-side guard that marks invoiceable tokens only on fully terminated responses? Noted billing concern.

emma: Customer asks if we can credit the partial request in the short term. Ticket owner?

support-bot: Billing alert created: BLG-7765 — billing team pinged.

tyler: Quick repro I ran (macOS):
```
# run server stream
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \n  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream?model=gpt-redwood-1" > /tmp/stream.out &
# emulate network flip
sudo ifconfig en0 down; sleep 2; sudo ifconfig en0 up
# check /tmp/stream.out ends with partial JSON
```
I saw the same truncated tail after bringing interface back up.

oncall-sre: Proposed short-term customer guidance:
- Add a client-level keepalive (application ping every 10s) to reduce OS tearing on quick switches.
- If using automatic token refresh, delay refresh until stream end or implement resumable tokens.
- On server side, we can suppress billing for streams that end with `stream_terminated_incomplete` while we investigate.

emma: Sent guidance to customer and requested full tcpdump. They asked for ETA on billing credit.

raj: I'll escalate to billing and mark as P2. Also logging: add a diagnostic flag that prints `stream_final_frame_complete=true|false` to make postmortems easier.

oncall-sre: I'll follow up with a small runtime change: demarcate final chunk with an explicit `event: eod` so client parsers that are fragile can detect incomplete final chunk. Low risk, will put in canary today.

emma: Thanks team — customer replied :thumbsup: and will run with keepalive + extended TTL and share tcpdump. Closing loop when they confirm.
